annotations.title: Change individual certificate settings of an exam

description: Change individual certificate settings of an exam. Every setting other than enabled requires the certificates to be enabled for the exam, and the items displayed on the certificates have to be switched on before their own settings can be configured (for example show_serial before the serial_ settings). The certificates configured by a preset can only be replaced completely, see edubase_put_exam_certificates. The settings cannot be changed while the exam is locked.

automatic_renewal_approval.description: approve the renewal automatically, but keep it revocable, requires manual_renewal

branding_edubase.description: display the EduBase logo, it can only be removed with the matching feature enabled

branding_image.description: logo of the branding, the same way as with signature_left_image

branding_line1.description: name of the organization, requires show_custom_branding and it is mandatory when the branding is displayed

custom_fields.description: custom user data to display as extra data, requires show_custom, at most three fields can be displayed, the custom user data fields of the exam are identified by their label (see edubase_get_exam_fields), the data fields of the user accounts by their customer_ prefixed name, send an empty list to remove every field

custom_user_fields.description: custom user data to display together with the data of the examinee, the same way as with custom_fields

download_automatically.description: download the certificate automatically when the examinee opens the results page

email_send.description: send the certificates to the examinees in email automatically, needs the certificate email sending feature to be enabled on the instance

enabled.description: issue certificates for the exam, needs the certificate feature to be enabled for the user, not available for surveys, and needs a grading that decides whether the test was successful (see the certificates flag in edubase_get_quiz_grading_presets), the configuration is kept when the certificates are disabled

expiration.description: validity period of the certificates in days, between 0 and 9999, requires show_expiration and it is mandatory when the expiration is configured for the first time

expiration_notification_emails.description: email addresses to notify about the expiring certificates, requires show_expiration, the examinees of the exam are notified automatically about their renewable certificates, these notifications are sent to the specified addresses only, send an empty list to remove every address

grading_threshold.description: threshold of the certificates in percentage, overriding the threshold of the grading, certificates are only issued above it. Accepts a number or a numeric string between 0 and 100, or "default" if the threshold of the grading should be used

language.description: language of the certificates, only the languages EduBase is translated to are available (default: language of the exam)

manual_renewal.description: the renewal has to be approved by a supervisor, requires renew

notes.description: notes displayed at the bottom of the certificates

renew.description: whether the certificates can be renewed, requires show_expiration (false: the certificates cannot be renewed, true: the certificates can be renewed any time, number: the number of days the renewal is available from, relative to the expiry, 0 is the day of the expiry, negative values open the renewal before it, at most the validity period earlier), default: false

result_format.description: format of the displayed result, requires show_result (points-percent-time: points, result in percentage and the time spent with the test, points-percent: points and result in percentage, points: points only, percent: result in percentage only), default: points-percent-time

serial_format.description: format of the serial numbers, requires show_serial and it is mandatory when the serial numbers are configured for the first time (prefix-year-index: prefix, the year of the test and the index, prefix-date-index: prefix, the date of the test and the index, prefix-index: prefix and index, written together), none of the serial_ settings can be changed anymore once a certificate is issued for the exam

serial_index_digits.description: minimum length of the index in the serial numbers, between 1 and 16, requires show_serial (default: 4)

serial_prefix.description: prefix of the serial numbers, requires show_serial, the serial numbers are only unique within the exam, so a unique prefix is recommended

serial_separator.description: separator between the parts of the serial numbers, requires show_serial, always empty with the prefix-index format (default: /)

show_birthdate_birthplace.description: display the birth date and the birth place of the examinee

show_custom_branding.description: display custom branding (logo and organization name)

show_expiration.description: expire the certificates and display their validity

show_result.description: display the result of the test

show_serial.description: give a serial number to the certificates

signature_left.description: display the signature of the first organizer, requires show_signature, the lines of the signature are kept when it is disabled

signature_left_image.description: image of the first signature, a new image replaces the current one: a URL, base64-encoded data (optionally as a data URL), or the identifier of an image uploaded to the filebin (supported formats: JPEG, WebP, PNG), the white background of the signatures and the stamp is removed automatically, but transparent PNG images are recommended (true: display the image that is already uploaded, false: keep the uploaded image, but do not display it)

signature_left_line1.description: name of the first organizer, mandatory when the signature is displayed

signature_left_line2.description: second line of the first signature

signature_left_line3.description: third line of the first signature

signature_left_line4.description: fourth line of the first signature

signature_right.description: display the signature of the second organizer, the same way as with signature_left

signature_right_image.description: image of the second signature, the same way as with signature_left_image

signature_right_line1.description: name of the second organizer, mandatory when the signature is displayed

signature_right_line2.description: second line of the second signature

signature_right_line3.description: third line of the second signature

signature_right_line4.description: fourth line of the second signature

signature_stamp.description: stamp displayed between the signatures, the same way as with signature_left_image

signature_user.description: display a signature line for the examinee, requires show_signature

supervisors_only.description: only allow the supervisors to issue the certificates, so the examinees cannot get their own ones

text1.description: text displayed under the data of the examinee, the multi line texts (text1, text2 and notes) support basic formatting (bold, italic, underline, subscript, superscript) and line breaks

text2.description: text displayed under the results, above the date of the test

text_date.description: text displayed before the date of the test

timezone.description: timezone of the dates on the certificates, or "default" if the timezone of the exam should be used

title.description: title of the certificates, certificates are only issued once they have a title

name: edubase_post_exam_certificates
